text:
ravi: hey team -- opening my first PR today. really quick: preferred branch prefix? PR size ceiling? commit line format?
emma: welcome ravi! We usually do `task/ENG-####-short-desc` for non-customer-facing work and `feature/ENG-####-short-desc` for features. kebab-case after the ticket.
chloe: PRs: keep them focused. target < 250 LOC or split mechanical vs behavioral. mechanical = formatting/renames; behavioral = logic changes.
ravi: commit messages: strict conventional commits or flexible?
emma: flexible conventional: something like `runtime: reduce kv memory (ENG-2145)` or `docs: clarify batch settings`. If you add a body, include testing steps.
chloe: always run `./scripts/preflight.sh` locally. If CI fails on flaky infra, push an empty commit to retrigger: `git commit --allow-empty -m "ci: rerun" && git push`.
ci-bot: [CI] Build queued for commit 1a2b3c4 : lint pending, tests pending
ravi: I hit a flakey test hitting redis occasionally. Should I mock it or note in PR?
emma: mock where possible. If mocking isn't feasible, open the PR, mark the flaky test in the description and request an infra rerun. Add `flaky-test` tag in the body.
chloe: reviewers: check CODEOWNERS. For runtime libs ping `@team-runtime` and tag `@chloe` if you want a quick look. Approval rule = 1 CODEOWNER or 2 reviewers. Security stuff needs `@sec-eng`.
ravi: merge strategy? squash vs keep commits?
emma: squash for tiny fixes; keep logical commits for features. If you keep multiple commits, make sure they each compile and have meaningful messages.
chloe: PR template snippet to paste in:
```
- Summary
- Ticket: ENG-2145
- How to test locally (commands/env)
- CI status / flakiness notes
- Labels: area/* type/* size/*
```
ravi: labels we use?
emma: `area/runtime|api|infra|docs`, `type/feat|bug|chore`, `size/xs|s|m|l`. Add `backport-needed` for patches to supported releases.
ravi: any blackout windows to avoid merging big infra changes?
chloe: avoid merging migrations/infra right before the 10:00 UTC deploy window. Coordinate early for DB migrations and heavy infra changes.
ravi: perfect. i'll open a draft PR, run preflight and paste the snippet. can someone eyeball before I request formal reviews?
emma: ping me in the PR and I'll do a quick smoke pass.
devex: welcome! happy to look at the description for clarity before reviewers are requested. congrats on the first PR :tada:
